candidate_association: Exact head/tree supplied by the release owner; this receipt hashes and visually inspects the six files in the supplied final artifact directory. It does not independently query GitHub.
scope: Bounded visual review of six changed miscellaneous-guide PNGs for visible text readability, containment and new horizontal clipping; not whole-page content accuracy or complete guide acceptance.
method: Manually viewed all six actual current PNGs, manually compared four prior renders, and read-only compared dimensions/pixel differences for all six prior counterparts.

screenshots.scope: Phone viewport of the expanded Mission 37 written route
observations: Visible numbered route steps, bold lead-ins and paragraph lines remain readable and inside the route card.
No horizontal clipping of the visible guide text was observed; the lower continuation is ordinary viewport cropping.
The entire body below y=112 is pixel-identical to the prior screenshot; the changed pixels are in the header Share control.

screenshots.scope: Phone viewport showing Mission 03 header and expanded route
observations: The Mission 03 title, checkbox, Close guide control, numbered steps and visible paragraphs are readable and contained.
A small vertical scroll/paint offset changes the rendered body relative to the prior screenshot; the text remains within the card with no new horizontal truncation.
Content partially outside the top/bottom viewport is a capture-position limitation, not proof that the full guide or filter behavior was audited.

screenshots.scope: Desktop viewport of the two-column side-mission list, including #22 A Call from Mable
observations: Both columns of numbered mission rows, checkboxes and Field notes controls are readable and remain inside the content area.
The fixed left navigation and visible list show no new overlap or horizontal clipping.
The body below y=112 is pixel-identical to the prior screenshot; differences are header Share text paint.
This screenshot displays the list including #22; its filename alone is not evidence that filtering semantics were verified.

screenshots.scope: Disclosure-summary element crop only; not a complete phone viewport
observations: The complete label Read all 66 source-numbered item records and disclosure arrow are legible within the 359-pixel crop width.
The current crop is 359x45 pixels; the prior crop is 359x44. The one-pixel height difference does not cut off the visible label.
This establishes the summary-label rendering only; it does not establish all expanded records, the surrounding page layout or the accuracy of the count.

screenshots.scope: Phone viewport of the Mega Dimension page introduction and three visible step cards
observations: The coverage notice, Beyond the city you know heading, introductory text and visible Make a donut / Survey the zone / Push the story cards fit within the page width.
Heading wrapping and body line lengths are readable; the visible card borders and padding remain contained.
The navigation strip shows a partial item at its left edge, consistent with the existing horizontally scrolling navigation; this is not a clipped body-content claim.
Pixel differences below the header are confined to a small left-edge portion of the coverage notice; the primary hero and step-card body remain unchanged.

screenshots.scope: Phone viewport of the Ranked Battles introduction, Online requirement card and start of step 01
observations: The visible heading, description, requirement card and first step remain contained and legible at the captured size.
The pale/muted presentation is also present in the prior image; the whole body below y=112 is pixel-identical, with only header Share-control paint differences.
No new horizontal clipping is visible. This is not a measured contrast/WCAG assessment or a verification of the displayed season dates.

limitations: The Zone 20 image is only a disclosure-summary element crop, not a complete viewport.
Only visible screenshot content is assessed; full-page scrolling, interactive behavior, DOM overflow metrics and formal contrast/accessibility measurements were not performed in this review.
Partially visible navigation-strip items and content beyond top/bottom capture edges are not evidence of horizontal body clipping.
No guide factual accuracy, displayed dates, inventory completeness, filter semantics or broader master-plan completion is certified by these images.
Earlier 377fb91 screenshots are comparison evidence only; they do not replace current-head CI or current release proof.
The six separately covered identical fashion-guide images were outside this review.
